title: The Importance of Tawakkul (Reliance) upon Allah and Trust in Him
reference_info: حقوق الأولاد على الوالدين - عماد عبدالعظيم (الألوكة)

text_simplified: The text speaks about the importance of tawakkul upon Allah and trust in Him in all matters. It mentions that whoever relies upon Allah, He suffices him and provides for him from where he does not expect. It also indicates that salah and worship increase the servant’s closeness to his Lord.

review_defects.why: The phrase 'tawakkul upon Allah' is not idiomatic English; 'tawakkul in Allah' or 'reliance upon Allah' would be more natural. The Arabic is simple and direct, but the English sounds stiff and slightly awkward.
